request.text: pgustavo's elevated PowerShell on WORKSTATION5 is enumerating local accounts. Disable account pgustavo.

package.rationale: A high-integrity PowerShell of pgustavo (PID 7456) opened and started net.exe user, which ran net1 user, to list the local accounts of WORKSTATION5. The account is being used for local account discovery from an implant-like PowerShell; disable pgustavo now.
